## Dashboard workshop

### Data preparation

```{r}
library("dashboardr")
library(forcats)
library(tidyverse)

GenAIuse_groups = factor(c("Never", "Once a week", "2-4 times per week ", "(Almost) every day", "Several times a day"))

data = read_csv('data_modified_04022026.csv')

data = data %>%
  mutate(GenAI_use = fct_relevel(
    GenAI_use, "Never", "Once a week", "2-4 times per week", "(Almost) every day",
    "Several times a day"),
    Q8_trust_publisher = fct_relevel(Q8_trust_publisher, "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                     "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q8_realism = fct_relevel(Q8_realism, "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                     "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q8_misinfo_risk = fct_relevel(Q8_misinfo_risk, "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                     "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q8_human_in_the_loop = fct_relevel(Q8_human_in_the_loop, "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                     "Of average importance", "Very important"))

data = data %>%
  mutate(trust_news = case_when(
      kari_trust_news_media < 4 ~ "low",
      kari_trust_news_media > 7 ~ "high",
      TRUE ~ 'medium'
  ),
  trust_news = fct_relevel(trust_news, 'low', 'medium', 'high')
  )

# Q5 feeling thermometers (0 = negative, 100 = positive): reshape the five
# items into long format so they can be compared as side-by-side box plots.
q5_long = data %>%
  select(
    country,
    `Fact-checking`                     = Q5_fact_check,
    `Identifying content origin`        = Q5_identify_contents_origin,
    `Understanding the writer`          = Q5_understanding_the_writer,
    `Understanding journalistic values` = Q5_understanding_journalistic_values,
    `Judging human involvement`         = Q5_judging_human_involvement
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "item", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(item = fct_inorder(item))

authenticity_rankings <- data %>%
  select(country, starts_with("Q4_")) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric"), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

authenticity_rankings_ranked = authenticity_rankings %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric"),
                ~ rank(c_across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric")))[which(c_across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric")) == .x)],
                .names = "{.col}_rank")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("numeric"))

authenticity_bump = authenticity_rankings_ranked %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "item", values_to = "rank") %>%
  mutate(
    item = recode(item,
      "Q4_based_on_fact_numeric_rank"       = "Based on fact",
      "Q4_identify_origin_numeric_rank"     = "Identify origin",
      "Q4_expresses_character_numeric_rank" = "Expresses character",
      "Q4_journ_values_numeric_rank"        = "Journalistic values",
      "Q4_written_by_a_human_numeric_rank"  = "Written by human"
    ),
    rank = 6 - rank  # invert: rank 1 = most important
  )
```

## Background variables

```{r}
home = create_page("Home", is_landing_page = TRUE) %>%
  add_text(
    "# Welcome to our Global AI journalism Monitor!", 
    "We surveyed xxxx people across six countries",
    "In this monitor, you can explore respondents' x, y, z and zoom into country differences and similarities",
    "Explore the Survey data.")

scale_1_10 = as.character(1:10)

GenAIuse = create_content(data = data, type = "bar") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "GenAI_use", bar_type = "percent",
          x_label = "GenAI use", y_label = "Percent (%)", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "GenAI use", title_tabset = "Overall", tabgroup = "GenAI use") %>%

  add_viz(x_var = "GenAI_use", bar_type = "percent",

          title = "GenAI use — USA", title_tabset = "USA", tabgroup = "GenAI use") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "GenAI_use", bar_type = "percent",
```

## Authenticity

```{r}

therm_label = "Feeling thermometer (0 = negative, 100 = positive)"

authenticity_feelings = create_content(data = q5_long, type = "boxplot") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          title = "All countries", title_tabset = "Overall",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          filter = ~ country == "Netherlands",
          title = "Netherlands", title_tabset = "Netherlands",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          filter = ~ country == "Denmark",
          title = "Denmark", title_tabset = "Denmark",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          filter = ~ country == "USA",
          title = "USA", title_tabset = "USA",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          filter = ~ country == "Brazil",
          title = "Brazil", title_tabset = "Brazil",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          filter = ~ country == "South Africa",
          title = "South Africa", title_tabset = "South Africa",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "item", horizontal = TRUE,
          filter = ~ country == "Japan",
          title = "Japan", title_tabset = "Japan",
          x_label = "", y_label = therm_label,
          tooltip_suffix = " / 100", tabgroup = "Background Variables/Authenticity Feelings")

authenticity_feelings %>% preview()
```

```{r}
countries_order = c("Netherlands", "Denmark", "USA", "Brazil", "South Africa", "Japan")

bump_viz = viz_timeline(
  data       = authenticity_bump,
  time_var   = "country",
  y_var      = "rank",
  group_var  = "item",
  agg        = "none",
  chart_type = "line",
  title      = "How countries rank authenticity dimensions",
  y_label    = "Rank",
  y_min      = 1,
  y_max      = 5,
) %>%
  hc_yAxis(reversed = TRUE, min = 1, max = 5)

authenticity_ranking_viz = create_content(data = authenticity_bump, type = "timeline") %>%   add_hc(bump_viz)

authenticity_ranking_viz %>% preview
```

## Regulatory preferences

### Top 3 aspects of life that AI regulation should protect

```{r}
q11_colors = c(
  "Economic wellbeing"                   = "#4E79A7",
  "Technological innovation"             = "#F28E2B",
  "Religious beliefs / local traditions" = "#E15759",
  "Human rights"                         = "#76B7B2",
  "Relationships with others"            = "#59A14F",
  "Environment"                          = "#EDC948",
  "State & national security"            = "#B07AA1"
)

item_order = function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    summarise(pct = mean(mentioned), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pct)) %>%
    pull(item)
}

q11_long = data %>%
  select(country, starts_with("Q11_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "item", values_to = "mentioned") %>%
  mutate(
    item = recode(item,
      "Q11_economic_wellbeing"                          = "Economic wellbeing",
      "Q11_technological_innovation"                    = "Technological innovation",
      "Q11_religious_beliefs_or_local_traditions"       = "Religious beliefs / local traditions",
      "Q11_human_rights"                                = "Human rights",
      "Q11_relationships_with_others"                   = "Relationships with others",
      "Q11_environment"                                 = "Environment",
      "Q11_interest_of_the_state_and_national_security" = "State & national security"
    ),
    mentioned = mentioned * 100
  )

Q11_mentions = create_content(data = q11_long, type = "bar") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long),
          color_palette = q11_colors,
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — all countries", title_tabset = "Overall",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "Netherlands")),
          color_palette = q11_colors,
          filter = ~ country == "Netherlands",
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — Netherlands", title_tabset = "Netherlands",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "Denmark")),
          color_palette = q11_colors,
          filter = ~ country == "Denmark",
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — Denmark", title_tabset = "Denmark",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "USA")),
          color_palette = q11_colors[item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "USA"))],
          filter = ~ country == "USA",
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — USA", title_tabset = "USA",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "Brazil")),
          color_palette = q11_colors[item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "Brazil"))],
          filter = ~ country == "Brazil",
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — Brazil", title_tabset = "Brazil",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "South Africa")),
          color_palette = q11_colors[item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "South Africa"))],
          filter = ~ country == "South Africa",
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — South Africa", title_tabset = "South Africa",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "Japan")),
          color_palette = q11_colors[item_order(q11_long %>% filter(country == "Japan"))],
          filter = ~ country == "Japan",
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Q11 aspects — Japan", title_tabset = "Japan",
          tabgroup = "Q11 mentions")

Q11_mentions %>% preview
```

```{r}
page_genai = create_page("GenAI use", data) %>%
  add_text("We measured this by asking ...") %>%
  add_content(GenAIuse)

page_news_trust = create_page("Trust in news media", data) %>%

page_chatgpt_trust = create_page("Trust in ChatGPT", data) %>%

  add_content(ChatGPTTrust)

page_authenticity_feelings = create_page("Authenticity Feelings", q5_long) %>%

  add_content(authenticity_feelings)

page_authenticity_rankings = create_page("Authenticity Rankings") %>%
  add_text("We measured this by asking ...") %>%
  add_content(authenticity_ranking_viz)

page_ai_journalism_attitudes = create_page("AI Journalism Attitudes", data) %>%
```

```{r}
background_menu = navbar_menu(
  text = "Background variables",
  pages = c("GenAI use", "Trust in news media", "Trust in ChatGPT")
)

authenticity_menu = navbar_menu(
  text = "Authenticity Perceptions",
  pages = c("Authenticity Feelings", "Authenticity Rankings")
)

my_dashboard = create_dashboard(
  title = "AI & Journalism explorer",
  output_dir = "GenAI_use",
  theme = "flatly",
  navbar_sections = list(background_menu, authenticity_menu),
  page_navigation = TRUE,
  pagination_position = "bottom"
) %>%
  add_pages(home, page_genai, page_news_trust, page_chatgpt_trust,
            page_authenticity_feelings, page_authenticity_rankings,
            page_ai_journalism_attitudes,
            page_regulatory)

my_dashboard %>%
  generate_dashboard(render = TRUE, open = "browser")
```

## Publish

```{r}
generate_dashboard(my_dashboard, render = TRUE)

publish_dashboard(
  message = "First version",  
  path = "./GenAI_use/docs"               
)
```

```{r}
Q5_by_question = create_content(data = q5_long, type = "boxplot") %>%
  add_viz(y_var = "value", x_var = "country", horizontal = TRUE,
```
